summary: Troubleshooting the browser build of AAPS (the AAPS-CI GitHub workflow): reading the GitHub Actions log, updating secrets, re-running a failed build, and fixing common failures (expired Google refresh token, preparation page server, repository permissions, keystore password). All labels on this page belong to GitHub, Google Account pages or the build workflow, not to the AAPS app.
